verdict.rationale: The Cactus repo says the engine exposes "OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision" (gh-2), offers a `cactus run` CLI command (gh-6), and can convert any HuggingFace model, though experimentally (gh-1). Nothing shows these APIs are served over a local HTTP endpoint rather than as in-process SDK bindings. missing for 10: a documented local server/serve command, an HTTP endpoint and port configuration, confirmation that it works for any loaded model (conversion is labeled experimental), and independent hands-on corroboration.
